_om: Femmeren in English (Fiver, rusj.no/en/fiver/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. The cards are in data.en/kort.json (prefix «Name three»), written for the UK. Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Et kort ber deg nevne tre ting – og du h: A card asks you to name three things – and you have five seconds.
Den som har tur, leser kortet høyt: «Nev: Whoever's turn it is reads the card out loud: ‘Name three things you find in a fridge.’
Klar, ferdig, gå! Lunta brenner, og du r: Ready, steady, go! The fuse burns, and you shout out three things before time runs out.
Klarte det? Trykk Ja eller Nei. Ja gir e: Made it? Tap Yes or No. Yes gives a point – and several in a row make a streak.
Synes noen det var lett? Med «Utfordre»: Someone thinks that was easy? With ‘Challenge’ they have to name three new ones in the same time. If they do, they get a bonus point – if not, the bonus goes to whoever's turn it was.
Choose 10 seconds when the little ones are playing.
Ikke likt kortet? Sveip det bort eller t: Don't like the card? Swipe it away or tap ‘New card’.
Trykket feil? «Angre» tar dommen tilbake: Tapped the wrong one? ‘Undo’ takes the verdict back.
Gjengen bestemmer hva som godtas. Er der: The crew decides what counts. If in doubt, it's a yes.
The first to reach {n} points wins.
Everyone has one turn each round.
Ten seconds gives the little ones plenty of time.
Fem sekunder er klassisk. Velg 10 s når: Five seconds is the classic. Choose 10 s when the little ones are playing.
Var det lett? Da må den som sier det, ne: Was it easy? Then whoever says so has to name three more – for a bonus point.
En egen skjerm mellom turene. Skru av hv: A screen of its own between turns. Turn it off if one person holds the phone.
Three new ones – not the ones {navn} said.
Tre nye ting – før tiden var ute?: Three new things – before time ran out?
Tre ting – før tiden var ute?: Three things – before time ran out?
Den som synes det var lett, må nevne tre: Whoever thought it was easy has to name three new ones in {n} seconds.
Ingen klarte tre på tiden. Prøv 10 s nes: Nobody managed three in time. Try 10 s next time!
Dere går rett til kåringen. Den med fles: You'll go straight to the results. Whoever has the most points wins.
